snippet.title: Diwali 🪔 par ghar ki bani mithai🤩#malailaddu #harjeetcooks #minivlog #diwali #shortsfeed
snippet.description:
Diwali ki safai karke main thak gayi thi, tabhi Baani kitchen mein aakar boli—"Mummy, mujhe Diwali par aapke haath ki mithai sabse achhi lagti hai, bahar ki mithaiyon mein toh sirf cheeni hoti hai, aapke haath mein pyaar aur swad dono hai!"

Uski ye meethi baatein sunkar maine jhatpat banayi sirf 5 minute mein banne wali super soft Kesar Malai Ladoo! Paneer ko grate karke usme taaza malai, doodh, kesar aur cheeni ke sath pan mein mix kiya aur dheemi aanch par gaadha kar liya.

Jab tak Baani help karne aayi, tab tak mithai ka mix taiyar bhi ho chuka tha! Haathon par thoda ghee lagakar gol-gol laddoo banaye aur upar se pista aur kesar se decorate kiya. Ladoo itne soft aur melt-in-mouth bane ki dekh kar hi munh mein paani aa gaya, lekin Baani boli—"Mummy dekhne mein bohot tasty lag rahe hain, lekin hum sab Diwali pooja ke baad hi khayenge!"

🛒 Samagri (Ingredients):
Main Base: Taaza Paneer (Grated) – 200g

Richness: Ghar ki taaza malai (Fresh cream) – 2 chammach

Flavor & Color: Kesar wala doodh (Saffron milk) / Chutki bhar peela rang

Mithaas: Cheeni (Swadanusaar)

Garnishing: Pista ki katran aur Kesar ke dhaage

Rolling: Thoda sa Desi Ghee (haath grease karne ke liye)

👩‍🍳 Banane Ka Quick Tareeka:
Paneer ko fine grate kar lein aur usme 2 chammach taaza malai mila lein.

Pan mein doodh, kesar aur cheeni garam karein, phir paneer-malai ka mix daal dein.

Dheemi aanch par lagataar chalate huye 3-4 minute pakayein jab tak mixture pan na chhodne lage aur bind hone lage.

Plate mein nikaal kar halka thanda karein, haathon par ghee lagakar gol ladoo baandh lein.

Upar se pista aur kesar laga kar sajayein. Ekdum halwai jaise soft aur daanedaar ladoo ready!
